rule: ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude are core for every audience. Perplexity is core for b2b and conditional for b2c. An engine runs for a study only when it is CORE for the study audience, or when it is CONDITIONAL and one of three conditions holds: the buyer asked for it, the study vertical is on that engine's relevant list, or the operator declares relevance with a written reason. Everything else is skipped and the skip is printed with its reason. Selection is a lookup, not a model call: same profile + same policy bytes = same plan.
amendment_rule: This file is never edited after its first measured run. A change is engine_policy_v2.json with the reason stated.
mixed_rule: An engine is core for a mixed audience when it is core for either b2c or b2b.

openai.label: ChatGPT (OpenAI API)
openai.basis: Largest consumer assistant in every source opened [REPORTED: E1, E2, E3]. Run in every prior aivis study [MEASURED: study2/data, realtor_v1/runs].

gemini.label: Gemini (Google API)
gemini.basis: Second consumer assistant [REPORTED: E1, E2]; with google_search grounding it is the nearest measurable proxy for Google AI Mode and AI Overviews, which have no public API. Proxy only: never pooled with, or reported as, those surfaces.

anthropic.label: Claude (Anthropic API)
anthropic.basis: B2C core by operator decision 2026-10-07: third at 10.3% in one app-share source [REPORTED: E1] and named without a figure in the local-recommendation survey [REPORTED: E3]. It was conditional in the first draft of this file; changed before any measured run used the policy. Cost of the choice: a consumer study makes half again as many calls as with two engines. B2B core is an operator default [EST: no B2B usage data opened]; all four engines ran in the PR-agency study [MEASURED: study2/data].

perplexity.label: Perplexity (Agent API, live retrieval)
perplexity.basis: B2C: about 45M monthly users against 900M+ monthly for Gemini and 900M weekly for ChatGPT [REPORTED: E2]; absent from the local-recommendation survey [REPORTED: E3]. B2B core follows docs/10 section 3 ("most research-relevant engine") [QUOTED] and is an operator default [EST: no B2B usage data opened]. relevant_verticals is a seed list [EST]; replace it in v2 when data is opened.

google_ai_mode.label: Google AI Mode
google_ai_mode.reason: No public API. About 1B monthly users [REPORTED: E2]; second for local recommendations at 23% [REPORTED: E3]. Nearest proxy is gemini with google_search; the gap is declared on the report face.

google_ai_overviews.label: Google AI Overviews
google_ai_overviews.reason: No public API. About 2.5B monthly users [REPORTED: E2]. Nearest proxy is gemini with google_search; the gap is declared on the report face.

meta_ai.label: Meta AI
meta_ai.reason: No adapter in run_bank_multi_v2.py. Grouped with Grok and others under 5% [REPORTED: E1].

grok.label: Grok (xAI)
grok.reason: docs/10 section 3 lists the xAI API as NOT BUILT [QUOTED]; no adapter in run_bank_multi_v2.py. Grouped with Meta AI and others under 5% [REPORTED: E1].

copilot.label: Microsoft Copilot
copilot.reason: No public API; excluded on the report face per docs/10 section 3 [QUOTED].

web_search_default.basis: Consumer apps search the web for local and consumer questions; an API call without search answers from training data only [QUOTED: realtor_v1/PREREG_realtor_test_v1.md]. B2B default off matches the PR-agency study rows [MEASURED: study2/data]. Perplexity always retrieves live.

models.note: Each model string is the one recorded in request_payload.model of committed evidence, not typed from memory; tests/test_engine_select.py re-reads the evidence files. Recorded is not the same as currently served: confirm every model with --smoke before a measured run.

search_on.caveat: This is the RESOLVED snapshot the API returned; the alias that was requested is not in the evidence. It is an older snapshot than the consumer default named in study2 reports. Smoke-test whether the consumer alias accepts web search before a B2C run, and pass it with --model openai=<id> if it does.

evidence.source: OODA Loop brief citing Sensor Tower State of AI 2026
evidence.claim: End of May 2026 share: ChatGPT 46.4%, Gemini 27.7%, Claude 10.3%; Grok, Meta AI and others under 5%. Metric not stated beyond 'market share'.

evidence.source: Scrunch Labs AI platform adoption page (figures attributed there to Google I/O 2026, TechCrunch, Business of Apps)
evidence.claim: Monthly users: Google AI Overviews 2.5B, Google AI Mode 1B, Gemini 900M+, Perplexity 45M. ChatGPT 900M weekly users (Feb 2026).

evidence.source: BrightLocal survey of consumers who used AI tools for local business recommendations
evidence.claim: n=455. ChatGPT 31%, Google AI Mode 23%, Gemini third (no figure). Copilot and Claude named without figures. Perplexity and Meta AI not reported.

evidence.source: QSR Magazine on a DoorDash consumer study
evidence.claim: 22% of 3,001 US consumers surveyed in March 2026 had used an AI tool to help choose a restaurant.

limits: Usage figures are third-party REPORTED numbers read through a page summary. Re-open each source before any figure leaves the repo.
The tiers are declared by the operator with those figures as the stated basis. No tier is computed from them.
B2B tiers and the Perplexity relevant_verticals list are EST: no B2B or per-vertical usage data has been opened.
Selection decides which API surfaces are called. It does not make an API surface equal to a consumer app.
